liebermann.description_de: Excerptum Lond. im Liber albus um 1420
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: London, Guildhall (Corporation of London), Liber Albus (c. 1420): its extract of Hn Lond
liebermann.notes: In Hn Lond only, Liebermann’s El is the extract of Henry I’s London charter in the Liber Albus (ed. Riley, Munimenta Gildhallae Londoniensis I 128). Elsewhere El is Oxford, Bodleian Library, MS 579 (see the next entry). The same MS is Liebermann’s Alb in Lib Lond.
